events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `tests/subsys/modem/backends/tty/src/main.c` where `test_receive_ready_event_raised` called `k_yield()` instead of `k_sleep(TEST_MODEM_BACKEND_TTY_OP_DELAY)`. Because the ZTEST thread runs at a cooperative priority (`-1`) and the TTY backend polling thread (`modem_backend_tty_routine`) runs at preemptive priority `10` with a 100 ms sleep interval (`MODEM_BACKEND_TTY_THREAD_POLL_DELAY`), `k_yield()` did not allow the backend thread to wake up and poll the TTY file descriptor. Replacing `k_yield()` with `k_sleep(TEST_MODEM_BACKEND_TTY_OP_DELAY)` (matching the other tests in the suite) allows the polling thread to run and raise the receive-ready event, and all tests in `modem_backend_tty_suite` now pass.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
